name: quickstart-steps
title: Quickstart steps
description: Up and running in three commands: numbered steps, each with a copyable command and what you should see, and a package manager switch.
docs: Pass steps (a title, the command, optionally what the terminal should print and a one-line note) and, optionally, next for the last node that links on. Add variants, one list of commands per package manager in step order, to get a switch in the heading, over the steps; a step a list leaves out keeps its own command, and the switch says politely which commands it is showing. Where the output depends on the package manager, give expected as an object keyed like variants: the reader sees the output of the manager they chose. Every copy button is named with its step number and title, the expected output is plain text that can be selected, and nothing is tracked or stored: use manager and onManagerChange if you want the choice remembered. A command that does not fit beside its button wraps, with the button under it. Words are translated through labels.
